request.style: English, gravelly male solo voice, upright bass, slide guitar, brushed snare, moody, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He who sent me is with me
He has not left me alone
I always do what pleases him
And many believed in the sign

[Verse]
So Jesus said to those who believed
If you remain in my word
You are truly my disciples
And you will know the truth

[Chorus]
And the truth will set you free
The truth will set you free
It breaks the chains of your mind
The truth will set you free

[Verse]
They answered we are Abraham's seed
We have never been anyone's slave
How can you say we will be free
We have never bowed before anyone

[Chorus]
And the truth will set you free
The truth will set you free
It breaks the chains of your mind
The truth will set you free

[Bridge]
Truly truly I tell you this
Everyone who commits sin
Is a slave to that sin
A slave does not stay forever

[Outro]
But a son remains forever
The truth will set you free
